technique_name: Create a customer persona for a business selling expensive antique furniture.
description: This customer persona is a 45-year-old married man living in a suburban area. He is an experienced investor and has an interest in antiques and collectibles. He is looking for unique and valuable pieces that are high-quality and will appreciate in value over time. His average budget is around $1000 and he has an upper budget limit of around $2000.
